levels.1: Complete the first route while learning its map.

levels.1: Use upgraded carried data for the higher setting.
levels.2: Finish the main route on Hardcore or above.

levels.1: Reserve the final difficulty for a developed arsenal.
levels.2: Finish the main route on Village of Shadows.
levels.3: Load completed-story data with a fully upgraded high-damage weapon and its native infinite-ammo perk, select Village of Shadows, clear the route, and preserve the resulting data.

levels.1: The expansion adds another camera presentation.
levels.2: Finish the main route with Third-Person Mode enabled.
levels.3: Start or load a dedicated Gold Edition run with Third-Person Mode selected, keep it enabled through the results screen, and retain the completed data.

levels.1: Several compatible restrictions can share one Casual cleanup run.
levels.2: Combine the speed, low-healing, low-spending, no-crafting, fixed-inventory, and close-combat goals where practical.
levels.3: Use Casual and a strong bonus close-combat weapon. Finish under three hours, heal no more than four times, spend no more than 10,000 Lei, craft nothing, never rearrange inventory, and obey the menu-stated exceptions for required ranged actions.

levels.1: Completed data can be chained repeatedly.
levels.2: Reach the main results screen three times on one profile.
levels.3: Keep loading the newest completed-story data for each replay. After the third results screen, open Challenges and confirm the three-clear counter before overwriting older backups.

levels.2: Complete every VR tutorial prompt on PSVR2.

levels.1: Each weapon family has a different physical action.
levels.2: Draw, reload, fire, block, and holster every available VR weapon family.
levels.3: During the VR run, test each handgun, shotgun, rifle, magnum, launcher, explosive, and knife interaction. Use both hand slots and confirm every acquired weapon can be drawn and reloaded correctly.

areas.location_cue: The platform DLC manager, merchant, Special settings, and Bonuses menu.

levels.1: The Trauma Pack adds a merchant weapon.
levels.2: Buy the DLC handgun from the merchant for its nominal price.
levels.3: With Trauma Pack installed, purchase the Samurai Edge, AW Model-01, place it in the inventory, fire and reload it once, then store it only after registration.

levels.1: One Trauma Pack cosmetic attaches to a firearm.
levels.2: Equip the Mr. Everywhere charm from the weapon-customization screen.
levels.3: Open weapon customization at the merchant, attach Mr. Everywhere to a compatible weapon, inspect it in first and third person, then leave it equipped through one save.

levels.1: A visual presentation option is included.

levels.1: The pack adds a separate artwork collection.
levels.2: Open the Trauma Pack artwork from Bonuses.
levels.3: View every page in the Trauma Pack artwork set once, advance to the final page, and return to Bonuses only after all pages have rendered.
